title: The Earth Is Leveled
art: 89:21-22: when the earth is leveled, pounded and crushed, and your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank. The scene shows the earth only: the coming of the Lord and the angels is not depicted.
Every life on the globe is a point of light (5:32); what each life carried is not shown, because only God knows it.
The look of the cracked earth is imagined.
imagePrompt: The earth seen from above as it splits open in long seams, the ground giving up its dead as points of light rise out of the fissures, a vast plain left bare behind them; then the seams closing and the plain left perfectly level and still; ink-wash and parchment texture.

beats.say: The Quran describes the Day of Judgment in pictures rather than in a report. First the ground: when the earth is leveled, pounded and crushed.

The seams open, and out of them rise the lights of those who were given back. Nothing is said of what they carried; that is known only to God. Then the ground closes over, and the plain is left level and perfectly still.

verse.en: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed - And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
